name: Dynamic FLS Audit Score-V3 -Safety Team Refer

stages.native:
with base_1 as 
(select 
b.id tid, a.task_instance_id--,a.id
,b1.first_name||' '||b1.last_name as "Auditor_Name"
,b.min_start_date as scheduled_date,b.result current_result,b.status as AuditStatus,b.score as CAS
--a.data as score
--,a.data_key as field_name
,b.created_on_date
,b.scheduled_start_time
,b.start_time start_time,date_trunc('month',date(b.start_time)) month
-- ,cast(json_extract(c.target,'$.name') as varchar) as centername
,cd.center_name centername
,case when lower(category)='hybrid' then 'HYBRID' else center_type end as center_type_1
,cd.ownership_type
, cd.business_line
,cd.city_name cityName -- cast(json_extract(c.target,'$.cityName') as varchar) as cityName
,cd.locality locality -- cast(json_extract(c.target,'$.locality') as varchar) as locality
,cd.center_launch_date, cd.center_service_id
,c.code,split_part(c.code,'__',4),assignee_id, aut.name as TypeOfAudit

from 
pk_curefitplatforms_task_management_system.task_instance b 
left join 
(select * from pk_curefitplatforms_task_management_system.task_instance_report where date(created_on_date)>=date('2019-01-01')) a on a.task_instance_id = b.id
-- and date(b.created_on_date)>=date('2019-01-01')
left join


(
-- create a new task template table 
select tt.*,t.id as new_tenant_id
from (select * from pk_curefitplatforms_task_management_system.tenant where id in (1,6,217,14) 
-- filter for cult and gym centers 
) t 
join pk_curefitplatforms_task_management_system.business_line bl on  bl.tenant_id=t.id
join pk_curefitplatforms_task_management_system.Task_Template tt on tt.business_line_id=bl.id

                                                                                                    ) tt on cast(b.task_template_id as varchar) = cast(tt.id as varchar)
left join pk_curefitplatforms_task_management_system.audit_type aut on cast(tt.sub_type as varchar) = cast(aut.id as varchar)
left join 
pk_curefitplatforms_task_management_system.task_target c on b.target_type_id = c.target_type_id AND b.target = c.code
join (select * from dwh_fitness_mart.center_dim where 1=1 [[and {{ownership_type}}]] [[and {{city_name }}]]) cd on cast(case when tt.new_tenant_id in (1,217) then cd.cult_center_id when tt.new_tenant_id in (6) then cd.gym_center_id when tt.new_tenant_id in (14) then cd.center_service_id end as varchar) = reverse(split_part(reverse(c.code), '__', 1))
Left join pk_curefitplatforms_task_management_system.user b1 ON replace(split_part(cast(assignee_id as varchar),'-',1),'+','')= cast(b1.id as varchar)
where aut.name in 
(
'Cult Pass Quarterly FLS Audit ',
'Quarterly FLS Audit',
'Gym Equipment Safety Audit',
'Fitso Quarterly FLS Audit',
'Lux Gym Quarterly FLS Audit',
'Cult EBO Store Quarterly FLS Audit'
)
and date(b.start_time) between {{Start}} and {{End}}
and Date(b.created_on_date) >= Date('2018-01-01')
-- -- a.data_key IN ('CRITICAL_SCORE') and a.type = 'ACTUAL' and b.status = 'COMPLETED' 
-- b.id  = 6181458
),
/* work starts for updation of CAS score below this line*/
base as
(
select distinct id as task_instance_response_id,
task_instance_id,
question,metadata,
json_extract(metadata,'$.isCritical') as critical_idenitfier,
json_extract(metadata,'$.score') as score
from 
pk_curefitplatforms_task_management_system.task_instance_response b
--on a.task_instance_id=b.task_instance_id
where --b.task_instance_id=13687574
--and 
lower(answer)!='na'
and created_on_date>date('2022-01-01')
and cast(json_extract(metadata,'$.isCritical')as varchar) ='true'
and json_extract(metadata,'$.score') is not null
),
final_1 as
(
select base.*,
ticket_id,
case when lower(ticket_status) in ('resolved','done') then 'CLOSED' else ticket_status end as ticket_status
,ticket_created_date,
ticket_created_date+interval '7' day as expected_ticket_resolution_date,
current_date-interval '1' day as current_date_filter,
--case when lower(ticket_status) in ('resolved','done') and ticket_closure_date is null then ticket_created_date+interval '7' day else ticket_closure_date end as final_ticket_closure_date
date(ticket_closure_date) as ticket_closure_date,
case when lower(ticket_status) in ('resolved','done') and ticket_closure_date is null then ticket_created_date+interval '7' day else date(ticket_closure_date) end as final_ticket_closure_date,
cast(score as bigint) as score_calculation
--case when cast(score as bigint)=0 and 
--,eta--cast(eta as date)
from base
left join 
(
select distinct 
ticket_id,
task_instance_response_id, task_instance_id,
d.status as ticket_status,
d.created_on_date as ticket_created_date,
cast(d.closed_at as timestamp) as ticket_closure_date
from 
(select * from pk_curefitplatforms_task_management_system.jira_tickets where created_on_date> date('2022-01-01')) c
join
(
select distinct 
id as ticket_id,
status,
created_on_date,
closed_at
from "pk_curefitplatforms_ticketing_system"."ticket"
where created_on_date>date('2022-01-01')
)d
on c.ticket_key= cast(d.ticket_id as varchar)
where lower(source_type)='odin'
) t1
on base.task_instance_id=t1.task_instance_id
and base.task_instance_response_id=t1.task_instance_response_id
order by cast(score as varchar)
),
final_2 as 
(select *,
case when score_calculation=0 and lower(ticket_status)='closed' 
and final_ticket_closure_date>=ticket_created_date and final_ticket_closure_date<=expected_ticket_resolution_date
then 100 else score_calculation end as final_score_calculation,
case when score_calculation=0 and lower(ticket_status)='closed' 
and final_ticket_closure_date>=ticket_created_date and final_ticket_closure_date<=current_date_filter
then 100 else score_calculation end as final_score_calculation_1

--case when score_calculation=0 and 
from final_1
order by score_calculation,ticket_status),
final as 
(select distinct task_instance_id,
100.00*count(distinct case when score_calculation=100 then task_instance_response_id end)/count(distinct task_instance_response_id) as CAS_Score,
100.00*count(distinct case when final_score_calculation=100 then task_instance_response_id end)/count(distinct task_instance_response_id) as updated_CAS_Score_7_day,
100.00*count(distinct case when final_score_calculation_1=100 then task_instance_response_id end)/count(distinct task_instance_response_id) as updated_CAS_Score_current_day
from final_2
group by 1
)
-- select distinct --base_1.*,
-- base_1.task_instance_id,
-- base_1.current_result as original_result,
-- base_1.CAS as original_score,
-- date(base_1.start_time) as start_date,
-- base_1.center_service_id,
-- base_1.centername,
-- base_1.ownership_type,
-- base_1.cityName,
-- base_1.center_type_1,
-- base_1.TypeOfAudit,
-- final.CAS_Score as Oringinal_calcultated_CAS_score,
-- final.updated_CAS_Score_7_day as cas_seven_day_score,
-- final.updated_CAS_Score_current_day as cas_current_day_score
-- from base_1 
-- left join final on base_1.task_instance_id=final.task_instance_id
-- where lower(AuditStatus)='completed'

select distinct
base_1.task_instance_id,
base_1.current_result as original_result,
base_1.CAS as original_score,
date(base_1.start_time) as start_date,
base_1.center_service_id,
base_1.centername,
base_1.ownership_type,
base_1.business_line,
base_1.cityName,
base_1.center_type_1,
base_1.TypeOfAudit,
base_1."Auditor_Name",
final.CAS_Score as Oringinal_calcultated_CAS_score,
final.updated_CAS_Score_7_day as cas_seven_day_score,
final.updated_CAS_Score_current_day as cas_current_day_score,

case when final.CAS_Score >= 90 then 'PASS'
when final.CAS_Score < 90 then 'FAIL'
else 'NA'
end as Oringinal_calcultated_CAS_score_result, 

case when final.updated_CAS_Score_7_day >= 90 then 'PASS'
when final.updated_CAS_Score_7_day < 90 then 'FAIL'
else 'NA'
end as cas_seven_day_result,

case when final.updated_CAS_Score_current_day >= 90 then 'PASS'
when final.updated_CAS_Score_current_day < 90 then 'FAIL'
else 'NA'
end as cas_current_day_result

from base_1 
left join final 
on base_1.task_instance_id = final.task_instance_id
where lower(AuditStatus) = 'completed'
